About me

🇨🇷 Costa Rican🌎 Three languages

I’m a senior at Northwestern studying Computer Science, Data Science, and Economics.

I’ve worked on financial data at Bloomberg, machine learning at impaKt, and software quality at MusclePoints. Outside those roles, I build products of my own.

Football was part of my life long before it became a dataset. I captained Furati FC in Costa Rica’s U20 second division, and I still follow FC Barcelona, Cartaginés, and the Premier League. BanterBoost is where the builder and the footballer finally met.

Away from the keyboard, you’ll find me following the NBA, playing chess, hiking, surfing, or looking for the next place to travel.
